arithmetic_scope: Exact F2 column algebra and finite matching on float64 input; not arbitrary-precision chord geometry. Ripser uses float32 endpoints.
saved_scope: Distinct saved closed budgets for the 60 clean samples, with each method-specific closure and complete graph. Not every intervening edge count.
version_scope: Environment recorded with these saved measurements. Use code/requirements.txt for release summary rebuilding and verification (pandas 2.2.3).
small_positive_lifetime_cutoff_scope: Only the independent seven-point matrix-reduction helper; it does not generate the main study diagrams. No positive interval is discarded for the saved witness.
